mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (participation_id, tx_type, payment_phase, order_id, payment_key, parent_payment_id, amount, status, reason, requested_at, approved_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{participationId}, #{txType}, #{paymentPhase}, #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{parentPaymentId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET payment_key = #{payment.paymentKey}, status = #{payment.status}, reason = #{payment.reason}, approved_at = #{payment.approvedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{payment.id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id, participation_id, tx_type, payment_phase, order_id, payment_key, parent_payment_id, amount, status, reason, requested_at, approved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT id, participation_id, tx_type, payment_phase, order_id, payment_key, parent_payment_id, amount, status, reason, requested_at, approved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE participation_id = #{participationId} AND payment_phase = #{paymentPhase} AND tx_type = 'PAYMENT' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
